entities.summary: Rustie is a Scottish musician from Glasgow. He is associated with the Numbers label collective and first received attention for his 2007 EP Jagz the Smack. He signed to Warp Records in 2009. His 2011 debut album Glass Swords won him widespread acclaim. His music blends disparate genres, including hip hop, rave, and electronic trap. Rustie was a composers & musicians from Glasgow (b. 1983-01-04, Glasgow). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
